description:
Intetics Inc., a global technology company providing custom software application development, distributed professional teams, software product quality assessment, and digital transformation solutions, is seeking an experienced Senior QA Automation Engineer to join our team on a full-time basis.

About the Role

We are looking for a highly skilled Mobile QA Automation Engineer to drive the design, implementation, and maintenance of a scalable mobile automation framework within a Retail Banking environment. The successful candidate will play a key role in establishing automation best practices, improving test coverage, and ensuring the quality of mobile applications across Android and iOS platforms.

Project Details
  • Duration: 6 months
  • Working Schedule: Full-time, aligned with BST working hours
  • English Level: B2 (Upper-Intermediate) or higher
Responsibilities
  • Design and implement a scalable automation framework aligned with current engineering principles and testing best practices.
  • Develop and maintain automated tests for Android and iOS applications using Appium.
  • Design and maintain Page Object Model (POM) architecture.
  • Create and maintain test scenarios and test cases in Xray.
  • Integrate automated tests with a device farm for cross-platform testing.
  • Automate collection and upload of test evidence to Xray.
  • Analyze test execution results and investigate defects.
  • Prepare test reports and communicate project quality metrics to stakeholders.
  • Collaborate closely with Development, QA, Product, and Business teams to ensure high-quality software delivery.

RequirementsMust-Have Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or an equivalent combination of education and practical experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in test automation.
  • 2+ years of Retail Banking domain experience.
  • Strong understanding of software testing processes, methodologies, and industry best practices.
  • Solid understanding of Agile delivery frameworks and testing approaches within Agile environments.
  • Hands-on experience with mobile automation testing.
  • Proven commercial experience with Appium.

Technical Skills
  • Strong experience with: Python. Behave (BDD).Appium
  • Experience building and maintaining automation frameworks from scratch.
  • Deep understanding of Page Object Model design patterns.
  • Experience using Xray for test management and reporting.
  • Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Familiarity with mobile device farms and cloud-based testing platforms.

Soft Skills
  • Ability to coordinate efforts across multiple teams and stakeholders.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to build effective working relationships with senior management and cross-functional teams.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Collaborative mindset and ability to work effectively within distributed teams.

Nice to Have
  • Experience with BrowserStack, Sauce Labs, AWS Device Farm, or similar mobile testing platforms.
  • Experience working in Banking, Financial Services, or other regulated industries.
  • Knowledge of advanced BDD practices and testing strategies.
  • Experience with test reporting dashboards and quality metrics.

What We Offer
  • Opportunity to work on a large-scale Retail Banking project.
  • International and collaborative working environment.
  • Professional growth and development opportunities.
  • Flexible and supportive work culture.
  • Long-term cooperation opportunities based on project performance and business needs.
